title: ObjectStatus
description: Fiori object status (sap.m.ObjectStatus look): label, icon and text in a semantic or indication color; inverted badge, large and active variants.

usage.summary: Show the semantic state of a business object with status text and an optional icon.
useWhen: Help users assess the state of an item, process or workflow at a glance.
Keep status text next to the business object it describes, including in table cells and list items.
Use state for semantic meaning, and active when pressing the status opens related details.

avoidWhen.when: Highlight a category or condition as a compact enclosed marker rather than a labeled object state.
Show a business amount or quantity with its unit rather than a textual state.
Explain a warning or status change that applies to a page or section.
